_schema.question: {en, es, de}; es/de only for the ~20 translated questions, otherwise null
_schema.gold: chunk-level article/annex ids that must be cited, e.g. ai_act:art5, ai_act:anxIII, gdpr:art22. Empty list for unanswerable questions
_schema.gold_any: true if citing ANY gold id counts as correct (default false = all gold ids expected)
_schema.notes: free text: why this is the answer, tricky points

question.en: Is an AI system used to screen job applicants a high-risk system?
question.es: ¿Un sistema de selección de personal con IA es de alto riesgo?

questions.notes: Example from the project brief. Annex III, point 4(a): recruitment or selection of natural persons.

question.en: What obligations does a provider of a general-purpose AI model have?
question.es: ¿Qué tiene que hacer un proveedor de modelos de propósito general?

questions.notes: Example from the project brief. Art. 55 adds obligations for models with systemic risk.

question.en: How does the AI Act relate to the GDPR when personal data are processed?
question.es: ¿Cómo se relaciona el AI Act con el RGPD en el tratamiento de datos personales?

questions.notes: Example from the project brief. Art. 2(7) AI Act: the Regulation does not affect the GDPR. Candidates to add: Art. 4a (special categories of data for bias detection, inserted by the Digital Omnibus on AI), Art. 26(9) (DPIA).
Write ~10 of these: plausible questions the two texts do not answer (e.g. national fine amounts in one country, other laws, case law, future guidelines).
